Name: (AT) Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings for AT
Author: lianace
AuthorLabel: lianace - strawberrymilk95 - iamreallinbei - naeldeus - bruttapersona - mipperdoo - hypercation
Description:
[size=3]By popular demand, I converted Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings to alternative textures. [/size][b][s]It does not include the slime hutch[/s][/b][size=3][s], since the size of the slime hutch was made smaller in 1.6 and I couldn't get the texture to look right.[/s] Edit: Now includes a slime hutch in 1.1.0! Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/165351458]DPitSimp[/url] who made the texture. Edit: 1.2.0 includes even more slime hutches, thanks to mipperdoo! I also included some beautiful buildings by bruttapersona, LinBun and naeldeus made to match Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings. As far as I can tell, they are no longer active in the modding community and their mods are abandoned. If strawberrymilk95, bruttapersona, LinBun or naeldus would like me to remove their buildings used in this mod, please let me know.[/size]

[b][size=4]This mod does not replace the original buildings by default, it simply adds additional textures that you can set using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. You will need to have AT installed, and purchase the paint bucket tool from Robin to customize the buildings.[/size][/b]

[size=3]The assets might look a bit blurry in the pink preview images because I scaled them up, but they look as they should in game! Check the in-game screenshots for a better preview of what they look like.[/size]

[size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22304]Matching shipping box here![/url][/size]

[size=3]This mod includes the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22566]slime hutches mipperdoo posted here[/url], who kindly gave me permission to include them in this mod. If you have both this mod and their slime hutches installed, you will likely end up with the same slime hutch textures showing up twice in the texture selection menu. If you just want the slime hutches, mipperdoo's mod is a great choice!

All the credit goes to strawberrymilk95, iamreallinbei, naeldeus, bruttapersona, DPitSimp and mipperdoo for the textures used. All I did was convert their work to AT.[/size]
